from worker import execute

def test_submit_valid_modes():
    # Mock enqueue
    def mock_enqueue(p): return p
    
    for m in ["all", "remote", "hybrid", "office"]:
        res = submit("user1", mock_enqueue, mode=m)
        assert res["owner"] == "user1"
        assert res["mode"] == m

def test_submit_invalid_mode():
    def mock_enqueue(p): return p
    try:
        submit("user1", mock_enqueue, mode="invalid")
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_worker_filter_none_mode():
    task = {"owner": "user1", "mode": "remote"}
    jobs = [
        {"owner": "user2", "mode": None},
        {"owner": "user3", "mode": "office"}, # mismatch
        {"owner": "user4", "mode": "remote"},  # match
        {"owner": "user5"}                       # missing mode
    ]
    res = execute(task, jobs)
    # Should keep None, missing mode, and matching remote
    # "user3" is mismatch
    owners = [j["owner"] for j in res]
    assert "user2" in owners
    assert "user4" in owners
    assert "user5" in owners
    assert "user3" not in owners

def test_worker_filter_all_mode():
    task = {"owner": "user1", "mode": "all"}
    jobs = [
        {"owner": "user2", "mode": "remote"},
        {"owner": "user3", "mode": "office"},
        {"owner": "user4", "mode": "hybrid"},
        {"owner": "user5", "mode": None}
    ]
    res = execute(task, jobs)
    assert len(res) == 4
    owners = [j["owner"] for j in res]
    assert set(owners) == {"user2", "user3", "user4", "user5"}

def test_worker_filter_remote_mode():
    task = {"owner": "user1", "mode": "remote"}
    jobs = [
        {"owner": "user2", "mode": "remote"},
        {"owner": "user3", "mode": "office"},
        {"owner": "user4", "mode": "hybrid"},
        {"owner": "user5", "mode": None},
        {"owner": "user6", "mode": "all"}
    ]
    res = execute(task, jobs)
    # Should keep remote, None, all
    owners = [j["owner"] for j in res]
    assert "user2" in owners
    assert "user5" in owners
    assert "user6" in owners
    assert "user3" not in owners
    assert "user4" not in owners

def test_worker_legacy_mode():
    # Worker defaults missing legacy mode to all.
    # This means if task has no mode, it behaves like "all"
    task = {"owner": "user1"}
    jobs = [
        {"owner": "user2", "mode": "remote"},
        {"owner": "user3", "mode": "office"},
        {"owner": "user4", "mode": "hybrid"}
    ]
    res = execute(task, jobs)
    assert len(res) == 3
    owners = [j["owner"] for j in res]
    assert set(owners) == {"user2", "user3", "user4"}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_submit_valid_modes()
    test_submit_invalid_mode()
    test_worker_filter_none_mode()
    test_worker_filter_all_mode()
    test_worker_filter_remote_mode()
    test_worker_legacy_mode()
    print("All tests passed!")
